curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As the neighborly mischief boils over, how far will both sides push their battle for one woman's heart?
curatedMovie.description: Peter Rabbit’s long-standing feud with Mr. McGregor spirals to new heights as both battle to win the affection of the kind-hearted animal lover living next door in Will Gluck's animated adventure.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and briskly paced—an easy-watching animated adventure ideal for family movie night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Blending energetic family adventure with lively comic sparring, it turns a classic garden clash into a breezy, cheerful crowd-pleaser built for effortless viewing.
